newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, Zagrebacka not traded.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, Zagrebacka not traded.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in uneventful trade on Wednesday which saw no deals in blue chip Zagrebacka Banka.
One trader said its shares, which changed hands at 1,860 kuna Tuesday, may be too expensive for ordinary punters.
* Six of 13 traded issues rose, four fell, two were flat and one was sold for the first time in months.
* Most active was again food processor Podravka, flat at 350 kuna on volume of 4,271 units.
* Fully-listed drugs firm Pliva dipped 13 kuna or 0.2 percent to 480 kuna on volume of 1,117.
* Top gainer was Adriatic pipeline operator Janar, up 1,500 kuna or 18.75 percent to 9,000 kuna but sold only 19 shares.
* Biggest decliner, Istrian hotelier Jadranturist, lost 25 kuna or 7.04 percent to 330 kuna with 190 units changing hands.
